questions.answerReference:
a. The three angles produce equal ranges because launch speed is constant.
*b. The 30- and 60-degree ranges match, while 45 degrees gives the greatest range in this equal-height, no-air-resistance model.
c. The 60-degree launch travels farthest because it stays airborne longest.
d. The 30-degree launch travels farthest because it has the largest horizontal component.
